title: Building and Evaluating AI Software Repair Agents
shortDescription: Program reactive and feedback-driven Python agents to repair TypeScript software, compile generated patches, execute regression tests, and measure outcomes.
learningOutcomes: Implement a reactive one-pass coding agent and a feedback-driven bounded repair agent in Python.
Use an actual coding model to generate a source-code artifact for a reported defect.
Compile generated TypeScript code and evaluate regression tests for three software maintenance incidents.
Compare task success, elapsed time, agent-to-tool messages, data exchanged and language-model token use.

courseAlignment.evidence: Reason about state and decisions in two software engineering agent strategies.
Implement and execute Python agent policies and TypeScript patch generation.
Interpret empirical effectiveness and communication overhead.

tasks.title: Reproduce the three software defects
tasks.description: Inspect the TypeScript source and record compilation and behavioural failures.

tasks.title: Implement reactive and intelligent agents
tasks.description: Program Python functions and verify agent decisions.

tasks.title: Execute generated repairs
tasks.description: Connect Gemini, compile actual generated code, and run regression tests.

tasks.title: Compare measured performance
tasks.description: Analyse task success, time, worker messages and model usage.

tasks.title: Prepare and submit technical report
tasks.description: Attach evidence and explain decisions, failures and experimental limitations.
